title: Taiho and Cullinan’s zipalertinib clears Phase 3, teeing up first-line competition
snippet: Taiho Pharmaceutical and Cullinan Therapeutics’ cancer asset is already under FDA review in a later setting, with a decision expected by February.

title: Zealand sells milestone, royalty rights to rare blood cancer asset for up to $100M
snippet: The terms of the agreement with Royalty Pharma suggest the market potential of Zealand Pharma’s polycythemia vera drug candidate may be undervalued, according to Jefferies analysts.

title: Bankrupt Sangamo offloads assets to Lilly, PTC in $161M sale
snippet: PTC Therapeutics emerged as the winning bidder over Astellas for Sangamo Therapeutics’ Fabry disease gene therapy, while Eli Lilly is purchasing the biotech’s prion disease program and several platforms.
